name: AVA 数据分析
description: Analyze local files, databases and Feishu/Lark Bitable with AVA. Explore data, verify metrics, and create interactive charts and traceable analysis reports.
description_zh: 分析本地文件、数据库和飞书多维表格，探索数据、核对指标，生成交互图表和可追溯的分析报告。
description_en: Analyze local files, databases and Feishu/Lark Bitable with AVA. Explore data, verify metrics, and create interactive charts and traceable analysis reports.
examples_zh: 分析我上传的 CSV，核对收入变化
连接数据库，找出收入变化最大的产品
核对各产品变化之和，并生成图表
examples_en: Analyze my CSV and verify revenue changes
Connect my database and find the largest product changes
Reconcile product contributions and create a chart
